title: Shell socket on TCP port 22
caption: The supplied socket table associates the same kernel socket with sshd, sh, python3, and bash on the .35:48411 connection. TCP/22 alone does not prove an authenticated SSH session.

title: Miner connection and SSH forwarding
caption: SSH PID 975 connects to 192.168.5.95:22 and listens on loopback port 3333. Top PID 977 connects to that loopback listener, consistent with the recovered launch command.
